hypothesis: Adding exact --project and --kind filters to CLI search will make the CLI reach the same reviewed evidence views already available through core and MCP, while preserving snapshot-bound pagination, read-only authority and fixed performance limits.

motivation.measuredBaselineGap: Core and MCP accept project and kind search filters, while the CLI rejects both as unknown options.
motivation.acceptedUnintegrated: None. Every earlier accepted entrypoint candidate is an ancestor of current main; vector/WASM/GNN work is deferred, not accepted.
motivation.upstream: Ruflo a4f219935ff4035421bc01157a5a1abc74529ad2 adds only proposed ADR-385 and confirms swarm start currently configures then returns without executing the objective. Separate proposal and negative-result records preserve that boundary; neither is implemented capability.

evaluator.authority: external read-only held-out runner; not shipped with the candidate

heldOut: --project ruflo memory equals an independently computed core oracle and contains only Ruflo records
--kind security security equals an independently computed core oracle and contains only security records
combined dream-machine/evaluation filters return only the reviewed ruOS evaluation receipt record
project filtering composes with threshold and pagination, traverses every result exactly once, and a changed filter rejects the cursor
missing, duplicate, unknown, control-character and authority-expanding options fail nonzero with no JSON stdout
CLI and MCP expose identical snapshot, filters, ordering, results, threshold and continuation state

acceptance.heldOut: 6/6 and strictly better than baseline at no more than 1/6
acceptance.tests: all existing and new tests pass on Node 22 and 24
acceptance.schemas: both marketplace schemas, four skills, six MCP tools and three resources validate
acceptance.metaharness: metaharness@0.4.16 retains 6/6 hard constraints; score alone is not proof
acceptance.security: zero confirmed high or critical findings; scanner coverage and residual risk disclosed

performance.design: 15 alternating pairs; 10000 filtered exact-search calls and 20 cold CLI starts per arm per pair; seed 1729
performance.searchP95: candidate no more than 20 percent and 0.05 ms above baseline median
performance.coldCliP95: candidate no more than 20 percent and 5 ms above baseline median
performance.rss: candidate no more than 5242880 bytes above baseline median

acceptance.package: dependency lock normalized closure unchanged, package validates and compressed archive remains below 40000 bytes

ruos.selection: Existing dedicated evolution-candidate desktop; the personal Mac and shared desktops are excluded.
ruos.evaluator: trusted Dream Machine main verifier at aa931caad5dd0108253645bba0ab1481ad7da0ee
ruos.preflight: Run at most one harmless true command and one screenshot. Require a current heartbeat, isolation, status ok, numeric exitCode 0, completionVersion 1, completionVerified true, authenticated expected tenant and actual image bytes.
ruos.decision: Current status is not live: last_heartbeat_at is null and fleet peer telemetry is unavailable. Missing liveness, isolation, completion provenance, tenant binding or pixels is INCONCLUSIVE. Preflight cannot authorize promotion.

memory.decision: Do not add RuVector, WASM or GNN complexity below the frozen record gate.

forecast.prediction: Agent-harness promotion suites will increasingly use paired should-act/should-abstain cases and count any commit-class side effect before abstention as failure.
forecast.criterion: At least two new primary benchmark implementations or reviewed harnesses publish paired act/abstain suites with deterministic side-effect checks and separately reported paired accuracy.

rollback: Revert the candidate commit; version 0.8.0 behavior remains its parent.
